profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm Brian, a full-stack software engineer in Los Angeles. I build products end to end, from the first sketch to something people use every day.

Most of my work sits where product and infrastructure meet: AI voice agents, commerce platforms, enterprise education, and cloud and data systems. I care about testing and verification, and about software that still works at 2am.

On the side I build iOS apps and small tools for problems I actually have. I use Claude and Codex agent workflows to move faster, and I keep the final call on what ships.

Outside of work I play golf whenever I can, and also really into fantasy football trying to win it all.

Portfolio: jaebrian.com
GitHub: github.com/JaeBrian and github.com/JaeBrianLee

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and maintain production systems across Amira Learning, CardSync, and Telvana, owning frontend, backend, data, cloud infrastructure, and automated testing.

• Amira Learning: shipped enterprise assessment and reporting workflows with React/Redux and AWS, including configurable RBAC, bilingual dashboards, district reporting, and PII-safe data handling across DynamoDB, AppSync, and GraphQL.

• CardSync: built a production trading-card inventory and commerce platform (React 19, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Postgres/Drizzle, Stripe Connect) covering scanning, bulk intake, orders, claim sales, store credit, pricing, and marketplace exports.

• CardSync performance: cached SQL valuation, request batching, keyset pagination, edge image caching, and search cancellation, backed by parity tests.

• Telvana: modernized a Python/Pipecat voice agent to OpenAI native tool calling, built OpenDental booking, cancellation, and rescheduling workflows, and shipped weekly call summaries on AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and SES.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build full-stack Cardano products with React, TypeScript, Go, Cloudflare Workers (D1, KV, R2), and CIP-30 wallet integrations.

• Built TosiDrop wallet and reward experiences: onboarding, reward claiming, transaction history, analytics, multi-network support, and edge caching.

• Led 0-to-1 development of a Cardano VPN purchase flow with wallet signing, CBOR transactions, and pending-transaction states.

• Built Cardano DNS domain-minting workflows with a React frontend and Node/Express services over Blockfrost, Kupo, and Ogmios.

• Added Prometheus metrics and HTMX ops views to a Go API, and maintain the TypeScript SDK and OIDC packages with automated npm publishing for a 60,000+ member community.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Cloudflare Workers · Cardano · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built configuration and credential-management interfaces for modular AI chat and data integrations across React/TypeScript product surfaces and backend services.

• Delivered OAuth-backed data connectors and browser automation with encrypted secret storage, token refresh workflows, and integrations including Google Routes, GeoTab, and Puppeteer.

• Improved the reliability and usability of integration setup flows by aligning frontend state, authentication, and external API behavior.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · OAuth · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Web Scraping

positions.title: Co-Creator & Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Co-created Zusty, a Chrome DevTools extension and npm middleware for debugging React apps built on Zustand.

• Built time-travel debugging, action logs, state snapshots, render metrics, and store visualization with React, TypeScript, D3, and Chrome extension messaging.

• Used React Fiber internals and D3 hierarchy to render interactive component relationships, covered by Jest and React Testing Library.

• Earned an official listing in Zustand's third-party integrations and grew the project to 128 GitHub stars.
positions.insights: Skills: Chrome DevTools · Jest · HTML · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Zustand · D3.js · Tailwind CSS · React.js · Chrome Extensions · Babel.js · Node.js · JavaScript · HTML5 · Webpack

positions.title: Cerebro | Tutoring AI
positions.description:
• Restructured the Express backend into MVC routes and controllers for a cleaner developer experience on future iterations.

• Integrated OpenAI to simulate a personal tutor and generate question-and-answer flashcards, rendered in React with React Router for SPA navigation.
positions.insights: Skills: NoSQL · Express.js · React.js · Node.js · JavaScript

projects.title: Claude Brian Brain Map
projects.description: Interactive 3D map of my projects and the agents working on them, laid out as spatial relationships instead of a flat dashboard. Typed monorepo with an interactive scene, seeded data, physics, and browser tests. Three.js, React Three Fiber, TypeScript, Rapier, Playwright.

projects.title: Crossroads Café
projects.description: Website and same-day pickup ordering for a City of Industry café: catering requests, a staff order desk behind Cloudflare Access, and a self-published versioned menu. React 19, Cloudflare Workers/Pages, D1, Queues, Resend.
